entries.title: Psalms 25:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Unto thee, Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 25:2
segments: My God, I confide in thee; let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 25:3
segments: Yea, none that wait on thee shall be ashamed: they shall be ashamed that deal treacherously without cause.

entries.title: Psalms 25:4
segments: Make me to know thy ways, O Jehovah; teach me thy paths.

entries.title: Psalms 25:5
segments: Make me to walk in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 25:6
segments: Remember, Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy loving-kindnesses; for they are from everlasting.

entries.title: Psalms 25:7
segments: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; according to thy loving-kindness remember thou me, for thy goodness' sake, Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 25:8
segments: ¶Good and upright is Jehovah; therefore will he instruct sinners in the way:

entries.title: Psalms 25:9
segments: The meek will he guide in judgment, and the meek will he teach his way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:10
segments: All the paths of Jehovah are loving-kindness and truth for such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 25:11
segments: For thy name's sake, O Jehovah, thou wilt indeed pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

entries.title: Psalms 25:12
segments: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? him will he instruct in the way [that] he should choose.

entries.title: Psalms 25:13
segments: His soul shall dwell in prosperity, and his seed shall inherit the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 25:14
segments: The secret of Jehovah is with them that fear him, that he may make known his covenant to them.

entries.title: Psalms 25:15
segments: ¶Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; for he will bring my feet out of the net.

entries.title: Psalms 25:16
segments: Turn toward me, and be gracious unto me; for I am solitary and afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 25:17
segments: The troubles of my heart are increased: bring me out of my distresses;

entries.title: Psalms 25:18
segments: Consider mine affliction and my travail, and forgive all my sins.

entries.title: Psalms 25:19
segments: Consider mine enemies, for they are many, and they hate me [with] cruel hatred.

entries.title: Psalms 25:20
segments: Keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I trust in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 25:21
segments: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

entries.title: Psalms 25:22
segments: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
